releaseNotes: Dropify v2.0.3.1: Remapped Home Screen, Quick-Play Bento Grid, Radar Spotlight Vinyl Billboard & Combined Artist Hub
Remapped Home Screen: 2x3 Bento Station Grid for fast access to Liked Songs, Circadian Daily Mix, Instant 10-Track Shuffle, Notebooks, and Recent Sessions
Radar Spotlight Vinyl Billboard: Rotating physical 2D record card with concentric vinyl groove rings, live stylus playback animation, and quick add-to-playlist
Artists in Heavy Rotation: Circular 2D avatar shelf with verified badges and deep-linking into artist catalogs
Billboard Top 5 Charts: Ranked 01–05 heavy-rotation chart shelf with rank typography and instant queueing
Dedicated Artist Discographies: Full artist profiles (AUR, Arijit Singh, Coldplay, Diljit Dosanjh) with subscriber counts and clean artist catalogs
Smart Song-to-Artist Suggestions: Search 'Tu Hai Kahan' -> interactive 'AUR' pill suggestion above results
Universal In-Player Artist Navigation: Clickable artist names in Fullscreen Player, Mini Player, and cards
Full-Screen Settings Page: 4-mode tactile Theme Modal (Dark, AMOLED Matte, Light, System) and automatic background update checks on launch
Dropify 2.0.2 for Windows PC — Complete A-Z Phone Feature Parity with Echo Music
Song DNA: Full Genius meaning and Wikipedia album/artist backstory insights without API keys
Analog Varispeed & Playback Speed: 0.25x-2.5x variable pitch and time-stretch speed controls
Sleep Timer: 5m to 60m with 3-second smooth fade-out and pause-at-track-end option
Offline Storage & Downloads: IndexedDB blob caching for 100% offline desktop playback
Universal Share: One-click Song.link / Odesli universal streaming link generation
Up Next Queue Management: Visual drag/reorder, remove, radio autoplay toggle, save queue as sketchbook
150 Hz Automix Bass-Swap Ducking: Smooth crossfade transitions with high-frequency crossover
6 Harmonic Orbital Ambient Glow: Real-time dynamic canvas aura driven by audio harmonics
Frameless desktop experience with Mica material, system tray, global media keys, and Discord RPC
